headline: Sygnum Rolls Out MultiSYG Bitcoin Loans with BTC Collateral
summary: Sygnum rolled out MultiSYG bitcoin loans as Bitcoin reached 80 percent of total collateral used within its lending framework.
why: Sygnum operates as a digital asset banking group, providing regulated crypto financial services and institutional lending products.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Institutional collateralization products expand liquidity options for holders using cryptocurrency assets.
